Companion submission to cmoi65drc000bl104fehrcah8 (RedHatAI/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4). Same measurement, posted against root model Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with quantization=NVFP4 explicit so it surfaces on the canonical model page.

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 + DFlash speculative decoding on a single DGX Spark (GB10 Blackwell, 128 GiB unified). vLLM 0.19.2rc1 + the DFlash off-by-one patch (without it, drafter reads pre-embedding state and acceptance collapses ~80%→3%). Sherlock prose, pp=128, tg=128, c=1, n=29 warm. tokSOut = 102.05 t/s MEDIAN (std 48.74 — DFlash acceptance varies per token). 2.37× over NVFP4 AR baseline (42.98 t/s). peakVramGb=87 at gpu-memory-utilization=0.50 (right-sized from 118 GB at 0.92, no decode regression). KV pool 294K tokens covers the 262K context with 1.12× headroom. MoE-A3B is bound by expert weights not KV — FP8 KV + alt attention backends gave <5% AR gain.

Recipe + Dockerfile + raw JSONs: github.com/my-other-github-account/spark-bench-reproducers/tree/main/qwen36-35b-a3b-dflash-spark (commit b8776d3, reproduces clean-from-scratch).

By @banana_baeee.

Sherlock prose, pp=128, tg=128, c=1, n=29 warm. tokSOut = 102.05 t/s MEDIAN (std 48.74 — DFlash acceptance varies per token). 2.37× over NVFP4 AR baseline (42.98 t/s). peakVramGb=87 at gpu-memory-utilization=0.50 (right-sized from 118 GB at 0.92, no decode regression). KV pool 294K tokens covers the 262K context with 1.12× headroom. Tried FP8 KV + alt attention backends to push AR higher — nothing beat default by >5%, MoE-A3B is bound by expert weights not KV. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Quark W8A8 INT8 on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70 via vLLM XPU. Accepted production-candidate frontdoor run, not diagnostic route-capture. Mean of 4 measured streaming /v1/completions runs after warmup: corrected after-first output tok/s=99.77, e2e output tok/s=98.27, TTFT=76.53 ms. Prompt/output 512/512, batch/concurrency 1, temperature 0, top_k 1, top_p 1, prefix caching disabled. Quality gates for accepted runtime passed earlier same day: exact, repeat canary, structured/math/code prompts, and 8192-token needle. Peak VRAM is total xpu-smi allocation across 4 cards; observed about 31.89 GiB per B70 because gpu_memory_utilization=0.95 reserves nearly all visible memory.
